# WorldRng

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/scene/`](../folders/src-scene.md)
> **Source:** [`src/scene/world.h`](../../../src/scene/world.h), [`src/scene/world.cpp`](../../../src/scene/world.cpp)

## Summary

The world's own deterministic random stream (mt19937_64 with platform-independent distributions).

## Description

World registry context variable emplaced by the World constructor, seeded worldSeed(base_seed, index) (splitmix64-based). Its distributions are implemented by hand so results do not depend on the standard library: uniform() uses the top 53 bits of one engine draw, normal() is Box-Muller from two uniforms (u1 clamped to >= 1e-300, one draw pair per call, the second value discarded), unitSphere() draws z then an angle. Consumers: BoxDropSys::init, the sphere roller code (goal and speed draws, stagger), RigidBodySys::createGrounds (one raw engine() draw for a HeightField with seed 0). HeightField generation also constructs a local WorldRng from an explicit seed.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `engine` | `std::mt19937_64` | seeded with the constructor argument (0) | raw engine; uniform/normal/unitSphere draw from it |
